notes: This graph is a machine-readable routing index, not theory authority.
Do not invent missing branches from filenames, worker names, or recurrence labels.
A worker change, method change, repository move, or bounded step does not by itself create a new branch.
Populate progressively from verified durable branch/task state; unknown fields remain explicit.

Nathan Direct 2026-09-20 reweights the active edge from excavation/preservation as the dominant mode toward bold sandboxed construction and projection/benchmark work. Excavation remains supporting infrastructure. Confidence attaches first to faithful representation/reproduction of accepted physics; it does not automatically transfer to SAT/H(s)H derivation, novelty, or validation.

branches.title: Geometric solver vs standard-equation side-by-side pipeline
branches.intent: Build an auditable Python-capable comparison harness for matched SAT/H(s)H geometric-solver and standard/reference-equation cases without hiding target leakage, fit freedom, units, transformations, or representation assumptions.
exposure_constraints: Do not treat numerical agreement as derivation or validation
branches.last_material_state: REWEIGHTED by Nathan Direct 2026-09-20 as a focal active-edge mechanism for the project’s construction phase: use explicit 4D geometric representations against accepted/reference physics in auditable side-by-side cases. Existing Lab guards remain controlling: inputs/fits/derived/predicted values and representation assumptions must stay visible; reproduction/agreement is not theory validation.
branches.next_cursor: Run the existing solver/tool inventory, then choose the smallest benchmark where the 4D geometric representation can be tested against a well-established mainstream reference result without target leakage. Record separately: representation correctness, derivational status, fit freedom, and any genuinely novel consequence.
branches.exit_criterion: One paired case runs through both sides from a shared manifest with reproducible metadata and an auditable comparison report.
